Calculation / sources

QQQ and BTC/USD: Yahoo Finance daily raw closes. XAU: GoldPrice.com spot USD per troy ounce (LBMA fixes / Metals.dev; CC BY 4.0). Shared calendar dates only; session closing times differ. No interpolation, no QQQ dividend adjustment. A scheduled collector refreshes public sources every 30 minutes and retains daily review inputs on persistent storage. Provider failures retain dated observations. The full performance view uses the last shared close before 1 October 2025. The 90-day performance view rebases its first displayed observation to zero. Leadership shows BTC/QQQ and BTC/XAU ratios rebased to the first displayed observation; rising lines mean BTC outperformance. Seasonal returns include the move from the last shared close before each window.

DO CONDITIONS SUPPORT THE SEASONAL PATH?
01 / FED → FUNDING COST

Policy and market rates

Checking policy target and Treasury-yield direction…

Policy sets overnight funding; longer yields determine the competing return and discount rate. Falling yields help only if price participation confirms.

02 / IRAN → OIL → INFLATION

Energy pressure

Checking the Brent trend…

The oil response tests the geopolitical relief story. An easing headline accompanied by rising oil leaves the inflation constraint unresolved.

03 / FLOWS → SPOT DEMAND

Participation versus narrative

Checking BTC versus equity-risk participation…

ETF totals are used only when the provider supplies complete, recent observations. Exchange OI and funding have a narrower scope than aggregate derivatives. Absorption requires order-flow evidence beyond this daily dataset.

TRANSMISSION INTO PRICE

Capital demand meets available market liquidity

Macro conditions shape demand and positioning. The response at liquidity levels determines whether the reset leads to expansion or further weakness.

Comparative performance loading; liquidity stage remains unmeasured.

THESIS CONFIRMATION

Reclaim + held retest + participation

Supports the proposed Nov–Jan advance; monitor conditions for a Feb–May extension.

RESET FAILURE / ALTERNATIVE PATH

Acceptance lower / failed reclaim

Continued deterioration challenges the reset read. A direct advance without a flush rejects the mandatory-crash premise, while leaving the broader bull thesis open.

The sequence is a scenario, not a measured attribution of buyer intent. The measured daily stage above uses explicit price, participation and positioning rules. Absorption, held retests and broad-alt participation are separate evidence gaps.
